heading: About Dr. Nahlah: questions.
items: A dentist who has trained for three more years after dental school in replacing and restoring teeth: implants, crowns, bridges, veneers, dentures and full-mouth rehabilitation.
Yes. He has been a Diplomate of the American Board of Prosthodontics since 2013, and he is a Fellow of the American College of Prosthodontists.
How is a prosthodontist different from a general dentist?
A general dentist looks after everyday care. A prosthodontist specializes in rebuilding missing or failing teeth, and designs the finished result before the treatment that produces it.
Where does Dr. Nahlah see patients?
At the Tysons Corner office, Suite 220 at 7901 Jones Branch Drive in McLean, and at 2855 Duke Street in Alexandria.
How long has Dr. Nahlah been in practice?
Since 2003, and in Northern Virginia since 2013.
